_readme: Template only. Copy to detection.json in this folder, fill it in and delete the '_example' line; the main_*.py scripts refuse to run a config that still has it. Steps 5 and 6 (main_evaluate2d.py, main_inference2d.py): the models to run. What they run on (the detection source), the metric settings and the training settings come from the files in "_include" (paths relative to this folder; a key set here wins over an included one). confidence_threshold = the inference cut-off: keep it low (0.001, as Ultralytics val does) so the saved predictions cover the whole precision-recall curve and AP is not truncated; the operating point (P/R/F1, tracking, drawing) is set separately by evaluation.pr_conf_threshold, visualisation.conf_threshold and tracking3d.conf_threshold. For a second set-up, copy this file under another name and pass it with --config.
